charts.title: Vehicle speed
charts.description: Illustrative acceleration, braking near 22 s and recovery. Reported speed drifts during the attack.

charts.title: Route comparison
charts.description: Approximate routes based on the original vehicle start/end coordinates; intermediate waypoints are illustrative.

charts.title: Distance travelled
charts.description: The planned length stays constant. Physical and reported cumulative distances come from their respective paths.

charts.title: Longitudinal acceleration
charts.description: Acceleration derived from the demo vehicle speed.

charts.title: Localization trajectory
charts.description: An illustrative filter reduces the artificial GNSS position drift.

charts.title: X position error
charts.description: Signed error: ground truth minus estimated position. Synthetic GNSS drift from 14–30 s.

charts.title: Y position error
charts.description: Signed error: ground truth minus estimated position. Synthetic GNSS drift from 14–30 s.

charts.title: Safety events
charts.description: 1 = detected, 0 = not detected. The first vehicle has an illustrative red light violation at 25 s.

charts.title: Time to collision
charts.description: A brief approach to an obstacle during braking. Gaps indicate no predicted collision.

charts.title: RSU coverage
charts.description: Two short coverage gaps illustrate entering and leaving roadside-unit range.

charts.title: Objects received from RSUs
charts.description: The cumulative count pauses while no roadside unit is in range.
